fillet_radius = 1.0

result = Pos(0, 0, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(outer_diameter / 2, thickness)
result = result - Pos(0, 0, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(inner_diameter / 2, thickness)

top_edges = result.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
result = fillet(top_edges, fillet_radius)

result = result + Pos(outer_diameter / 2 + tab_thickness / 2, 0, thickness / 2) * Box(tab_thickness, tab_width, tab_height)

result = result - Pos(outer_diameter / 2 - tab_thickness / 2, 0, thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, thickness)

part = result
part.name = "ring_with_tab"
export_step(part, "output.step")
